short: string literal opening after % in Python
notes: Probes: 0.53-0.85 in indented code on " '" and " ('", unindented 0.16 (a merged " '," token) and 0.28; `% cmds` 0.04, `% (a, b)` 0.05. Other string openers are weaker but real: `'>>' if append` 0.20-0.28, `("  " * depth)` 0.49, so the pole is wider than the % slot, and this test does not measure that wider reading.
